description: Combine up to eight metrics in a formula and read the result as a series, as CryptoKeyhole's Formulae workbench does: + - * / ^ and functions such as sma, ema, zscore, pct_change, change, corr, rsi, drawdown, realized_vol, rebase, cumsum and ifthen. Name each input with a letter: inputs {"a": "ckh.MVRVPriced", "b": "ckh.SpotPrice"} and expression "zscore(a, 365)". Without an API key the inputs are metrics whose plan is free, at 24h, 1w or 1M.

end.description: Exclusive UNIX seconds UTC. Leave it out to read up to the latest observation.

expression.description: The formula over the inputs' letters, for example "a / b" or "sma(a, 30)".

inputs.description: One to eight inputs: a letter to a metric id, for example {"a": "ckh.SpotPrice"}.

interval.description: Resolution: 24h daily, 1w weekly, 1M monthly. get_metric_metadata gives the intervals a metric offers.

start.description: Inclusive UNIX seconds UTC. Without it fetch_metric reads the latest year of daily observations (ten years of weekly ones, every monthly and yearly one).

name: run_formula
title: Formula over metrics
